description.en:
Restarts the camera-control state from where the camera is now: stores the camera handle, clears the queued moves and the finished flag, and reads the camera's current position and look-at point (CMND_GET_CAMERA_POSREF) as both the current and the previous point. The character to follow is kept.
CamCtrlInit and CamCtrlMoveTo call it; events also call it directly after moving the camera by other means.
The camera-control helpers keep their state in subev_ctx.cam_ctrl, the context of an event started by CallEvent. While such an event runs, CallEvent calls sysCamCtrlStep every frame: it applies the engine's camera move (CMND_GET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA) to the camera, keeps the look-at point on the followed character when there is one, and marks the move as finished once it is over (see IsCamCtrlMove).

examples.case: Taking the camera's new position into account after a message (real usage, from ev42102700.nut)
